cds.title: Western Kentucky University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025) gives applicants/admits/enrolled by gender only (summed); no residency or international split is published, so intl_applicants and intl_admits are null. B2 lists 74 nonresident undergraduates (all undergraduates incl. non-degree) and 13 nonresident first-time students. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled' column of C11. No early decision or early action; no waitlist; rolling notification. SAT/ACT percentiles in C9 cover only the 246 SAT and 1,844 ACT submitters.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'. C8F: 2.50+ unweighted HS GPA needs no test; 2.00-2.49 GPA must submit a test and reach a Composite Admission Index of 60.

cost.notes: CDS G1: WKU marked its 2026-27 costs not yet available and printed FINAL 2025-26 figures (tuition per year; required fees not readable in the CDS). International (nonresident) tuition $27,648 vs out-of-state $27,000. H6: institutional need-based AND non-need-based aid exists for nonresidents; 45 nonresident undergraduates received it (avg $27,705).
